Since cyclic volume, cases material, pmax, and connection distance are the same across all models, they could go in type_level. But it might be cleaner to include in matrix table anyway. I'll put in type_level since single value, but maybe put in model_level too? The schema says type_level for whole-cert attributes — single value. Cyclic vol 1.2 for all → type_level is fine. But I'll also capture the matrix table.

- rows for G1.6, G2.5, G4 (converting commas to decimal points)
- connection_distance: "Up to 160mm" → keep as string "Up to 160 mm" or {min:null, max:160}? In matrix table rows keep the string; in characteristics config/type-level could use range.

Hmm, careful about fabricating. The label says "1 Imp. ≐ 0,01 m³" — this refers to the reed device pulse probably. I can add characteristic `pulse_value` with value 0.01 m³. It's legitimately in the document.

Type designation: "RS / 2001 LA G1,6 , G2,5 , G4". Type designations list: ["RS / 2001 LA G1,6", "RS / 2001 LA G2,5", "RS / 2001 LA G4"]? Or just "RS / 2001 LA"? The certificate type field is "RS / 2001 LA G1,6 , G2,5 , G4". The designation column in the table says "RS / 2001 LA" for each. Labels say "Model RS/2001 LA" and size G1,6 etc.

I'll list type_designations: ["RS / 2001 LA"] and model family with model_id "G1.6", "G2.5", "G4". Maybe include full designation strings as well. I think type_designations: ["RS / 2001 LA G1,6", "RS / 2001 LA G2,5", "RS / 2001 LA G4"] captures "all type/model identifiers mentioned". Hmm, the table designation column is "RS / 2001 LA". Let me use ["RS / 2001 LA"] as the type designation and models G1.6/G2.5/G4. To be safe, include the full string too? I'll go with the three full designations as they appear on labels: "RS/2001 LA G1,6" etc. Actually the certificate header: "RS / 2001 LA G1,6 , G2,5 , G4". I'll use type_designations: ["RS / 2001 LA"] and let model_family carry the sizes. Hmm.

The rule says "all type/model identifiers mentioned". The labels mention "RS/2001 LA" model, and sizes G1,6/G2,5/G4. I'll use ["RS / 2001 LA"] with models. That seems cleanest.

Should model_ids preserve the comma decimal "G1,6" or convert to "G1.6"? The G-size designation is a standard gas meter size notation (G1.6, G2.5, G4). The certificate uses commas (Italian style). Canonical: G1.6, G2.5, G4. I'll convert to dots since rule says decimal point conversion. Values: qmax 2.5, 4, 6.

Accuracy class: 1.5.

certificate.date_issued: 23 December 2025 → ISO? Schema doesn't specify format. I'll use "2025-12-23".

project_number: The certificate number contains "25.02" and TER is "TER25.02" — project number could be "25.02"? Not explicitly stated as a project number. I'll omit to avoid fabrication. Hmm, "R137/2012-A-IT2-25.02" — IT2-25.02. The type evaluation report No. TER25.02 suggests project 25.02. I could set project_number: "25.02". It's plausible but not explicit. I'll include it? Rule 8: don't fabricate. It's an inference. I'll omit it.

oiml_issuer_id: not present — omit.

Issuing authority website/phone/email: not present — omit.

Components: none named (ancillary reed device optional — could be a component? "Ancillary devices: Reed device (optional)". Could record as component with role "ancillary_device", type_designations ["Reed device"]. I'll include it, alternatives null. Actually it's optional equipment, part of the type. Include as component seems reasonable. Hmm — components are "sub-assemblies the cert names". The reed device is named. I'll include it.

Revision history: revision "0", date "2025-12-23", changes "Certificate Issuing".

Test reports:
- {id: "TER25.02", date: "2025-12-23", pages: 34, role: "type_evaluation_report"}
- {id: "QW 2025/000133", role: "documentation_file"} — no date/pages.

Characteristics model_level also include pmax? Same for all models → type_level: maximum_pressure 0.5 bar. Cyclic volume 1.2 dm³ type_level. Connection distance: "Up to 160 mm" → type_level connection_distance: {min: null, max: 160}, mm.

Type-level environmental classes: "M2 / E2" → maybe two characteristics: mechanical_environment_class "M2", environmental_class "E2"? Or one: environmental_classes "M2 / E2". Keep as single string value.

Ambient temperature: -25 to +55 °C → {min:-25, max:55}, "°C".

Label details: The labels per model repeat the same data. Barcode type 128, data matrix. Not needed as characteristics; could skip. Maybe record barcode_type: "128" — too noisy; skip.

Sealing: metrological seal drawing 120070821, green RAL 6024. Could record in description? Skip — description is for the certified type description if present. There isn't a prose description beyond "Diaphragm gas meter".
